license_required.quote: A person engaged in the construction trades licensed under this chapter, as a contractor regulated under this chapter, as an alarm business or company, or as an alarm company agent, shall become licensed under this chapter before engaging in that trade or contracting activity in this state unless specifically exempted from licensure under Section 58-1-307 or 58-55-305.

interval_years.quote: Each license issued under this chapter shall be issued in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by rule.

required.quote: A contractor licensee under a license issued under this chapter shall complete six hours of approved continuing education during each two-year renewal cycle established by rule under Subsection 58-55-303(1).

hours_per_period.quote: shall complete six hours of approved continuing education during each two-year renewal cycle

period_years.quote: during each two-year renewal cycle established by rule under Subsection 58-55-303(1)

value: at least three of the six hours must directly relate to the installation, repair, or replacement of a heating, ventilation, or air conditioning system
topical_requirements.quote: For a contractor licensee that is licensed in the specialty contractor classification of HVAC contractor, at least three of the six hours described in Subsection (1) shall include continuing education directly related to the installation, repair, or replacement of a heating, ventilation, or air conditioning system.

available.quote: Subject to Subsections (4) through (7), the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and the applicant's license is in good standing in the other state, district, or territory where the license was issued.
available.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

requirements.value: License by endorsement available if: (1) similar scope of practice, (2) at least one year of experience under the out-of-state license, and (3) license in good standing in the issuing jurisdiction.

scope_protection.quote: installation, repair, or replacement of a heating, ventilation, or air conditioning system (HVAC) on a Subsection (1)(h)(i) project must be performed by an HVAC contractor licensed by the division

disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in a construction trade, acting as a contractor, an alarm business or company, or an alarm company agent, or representing oneself to be engaged in a construction trade or to be acting as a contractor in a construction trade requiring licensure, unless the person doing any of these is appropriately licensed or exempted from licensure under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Hiring or employing a person not licensed under this chapter to perform work on a project
disciplinary_grounds.quote: hiring or employing a person who is not licensed under this chapter to perform work on a project, unless the person: is an employee of a person licensed under this chapter for wages; and is not required to be licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applying for or obtaining a building permit when not licensed or exempted as a contractor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: applying for or obtaining a building permit either for oneself or another when not licensed or exempted from licensure as a contractor under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately misrepresenting or omitting a material fact in connection with an application to obtain or renew a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully or deliberately misrepresenting or omitting a material fact in connection with an application to obtain or renew a license under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing one's license to be used by another except as provided by statute or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving funds for a specific project and failing to pay amounts due to persons who performed work or furnished materials
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed as a contractor or representing oneself to be a contractor, receiving any funds in payment for a specific project from an owner or any other person, which funds are to pay for work performed or materials and services furnished for that specific project, and after receiving the funds to exercise unauthorized control over the funds by failing to pay the full amounts due and payable to persons who performed work or furnished materials or services within a reasonable period of time

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or deliberately disregarding or violating building, safety, health, workers' compensation, tax, or reporting laws applicable to a project
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed under this chapter, willfully or deliberately disregarding or violating: the building or construction laws of this state or any political subdivision; the safety and labor laws applicable to a project; any provision of the health laws applicable to a project; the workers' compensation insurance laws of the state applicable to a project

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to complete the approved continuing education required under Section 58-55-302.5
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if licensed as a contractor, not completing the approved continuing education required under Section 58-55-302.5

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act by a licensee that causes material injury to another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any willful, fraudulent, or deceitful act by a licensee, caused by a licensee, or at a licensee's direction which causes material injury to another

definition_quote.value: HVAC contractor means a person licensed under this chapter specialized in the installation, maintenance, repair, and servicing of heating, ventilation, air conditioning systems or any other work the division authorizes by rule in accordance with Subsection 58-55-301(4).
definition_quote.quote: "HVAC contractor" means a person licensed under this chapter specialized in the installation, maintenance, repair, and servicing of heating, ventilation, air conditioning systems or any other work the division authorizes by rule in accordance with Subsection 58-55-301(4).

methods_authorized.quote: "HVAC contractor" means a person licensed under this chapter specialized in the installation, maintenance, repair, and servicing of heating, ventilation, air conditioning systems

system_components_included.quote: "HVAC" means a heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system and the specific components that are a part of the system, including the gas line.

qualifier_required.quote: The division shall require a contractor to have a qualifier.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: If notice is given, the contractor's license shall remain in force for 60 days after the day on which the association ceases.
